title: Support for Resistance: Technical Analysis and Intraday Exchange Rates

application: Score first reversal and continuation at announced prices
limit: FX evidence does not validate ETF levels

title: Evidence and Behaviour of Support and Resistance Levels in Financial Time Series
finding: Their discovered barriers displayed bounce-history and time-decay effects
application: Test completed contact episodes and age since contact
limit: Our price contacts and structural levels use different definitions

title: Market intraday momentum
finding: The first half-hour SPY return measured from the prior close predicted the last half-hour return in their sample
application: Test opening information only at an observable later clock
limit: Their horizon is different from a five-minute update forecasting an opening level

title: The Price Impact of Order Book Events
finding: Short-term price changes in their NYSE stock sample related to imbalance at the best bid and ask
application: Potential distinct input if timestamped quote and depth data already exist
limit: Minute OHLCV and volume alone do not measure order flow imbalance
